title: Find a client's last call note
instructions: Every account manager logs calls in Orbit CRM. Follow the steps to find what Maya from Northwind Bakery said on her last call.

image.alt: Orbit CRM dashboard with the sidebar navigation on the left.

steps.title: Open your contacts
steps.note: The sidebar is the same on every page, so you can jump to Contacts from anywhere.

image.alt: Contacts list showing six people and a search box in the top bar.

steps.title: Search for the client
steps.instruction: Type **Maya** into the search box and press Enter.
steps.note: Search matches first names, last names and companies, so a first name is usually enough.

image.alt: Contacts list filtered to one result: Maya Lindqvist.

steps.title: Open the contact
steps.instruction: Click the row for **Maya Lindqvist** to open her profile.

image.alt: Maya Lindqvist's profile with Overview, Activity and Deals tabs.

steps.title: Go to the activity timeline
steps.note: Overview shows static details. Activity is where calls, emails and meetings are logged in order.

image.alt: Activity timeline with the most recent call note at the top.

steps.title: Review the last call note
steps.instruction: Read the most recent **call note** at the top of the timeline. Maya wants the first creative concepts by next Thursday.
steps.note: Call notes are what the creative team reads before a kickoff. Keep them short and concrete.

content.summary: You can now find any client's latest conversation in under a minute. Next time, try the same path for **Tomas Herrera**.
